name: City Timelapse
description: A cinematic 3D aerial timelapse of a city growing over centuries — wild coast, fort, village, stone town, grid, factories and rail, early skyscrapers, modern glass skyline at golden hour — with a huge ticking year counter, era lower-thirds, district labels and population. For history-of-a-city, urban growth, infrastructure and 'then vs now' explainers.
fonts: "Inter", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
